title: Slow Boat Report
description: Run the whole Reporting page — filters, both charts, the table, and a scheduled CSV job — under Practice mode's "Slow network" toggle, and confirm nothing on the page jumps to a wrong or empty state while requests are still in flight.
successCondition: With Practice mode's "Slow network" toggle switched on (every request delayed 2-3.5s), a test sets a date range, clicks Update, and confirms the page does not flash an incorrect empty/zero state before the delayed response arrives (StatTiles and charts should either show a clear loading affordance or simply remain in their prior state until the new data resolves, never briefly rendering "0" or "No data" as if that were the real answer); it then clicks "Generate CSV report" and confirms the pending Badge persists correctly through the extended latency before flipping to ready, with the Download link appearing only once truly ready.
hints: The toggle lives under "Network & links" in the Practice mode drawer, bottom-right of every page.

A premature "No data for this range" render during the delay window — before the real (non-empty) response has come back — is exactly the kind of false-empty-state bug this challenge is designed to catch.
